name: GHCL
why: Working capital healthy - debtor days 24 to 21, inventory days 217 to 199 (not rising)
Latest quarter Sep 2026: Good (sales +12% YoY, profit +19% YoY)
Cost quality excellent: costs falling, margin expanding, operating profit growing (costs 78% to 77% of sales)
Profits backed by cash: operating cash flow is 111% of 3-year profit
Sector cycle: Earnings improving but price not confirming
risks: Not at record: quarterly sales, quarterly profit, annual sales, annual profit
Latest concall: management tone cautious (headwinds / delays mentioned)
FIIs (foreign funds) cut holding by 3.7 pts in a year

guidance: As I have said in the past, the current pricing environment is a continuation of a cycle that has been playing out over the last 2 years, and we expect realization to remain soft over the next few quarters.
We expect the vacuum salt plant to operate at its intended capacity level by the end of FY27, while bromine plant will reach its intended capacity by the next financial year.
capex: We expect the vacuum salt plant to operate at its intended capacity level by the end of FY27, while bromine plant will reach its intended capacity by the next financial year.
Our Board has approved a capex of INR88 crores for developing the infrastructure of our own railway siding.
risks: The conflict in the Middle East continues to disrupt established materials flow while adding cost pressure.
Import pressure continues to keep realizations soft.
focus: Now let me turn to our growth and diversification initiatives.
Both these projects marks an important milestone in our diversification journey.
We will continue to execute our pillars with a discipline to make GHCL more diversified, more integrated and more resilient.
